q: Rényi entropy of order α is Hα(X) = (1/(1-α))log ∑p(x)^α. As α→1, Hα converges to:
exp: By L'Hôpital's rule, lim_{α→1}Hα = -∑p(x)log p(x) = H(X). Rényi entropies form a family: H₀=log|supp|, H₁=H(Shannon), H₂=-log∑p², H∞=-log max p. Each order captures a different aspect of the distribution's 'spread'.
